QuestInfo.name: [Theme Dungeon] Sakura Castle
QuestInfo.0:
When Tae Gong hooked an indecipherable book on one of his fishing trips, he didn't know what kind of a whopper he had. Wiz the Librarian is looking for someone to help him identify it, and it's guaranteed to lead to a Far East adventure!\r\n\r\n

- #eRecommended Level#n: Lv. 70 - Lv. 75\r\n
- #eRoute#n\r\n   
1) Accept the quest, 'Reading with Kino Konoko'\r\n   
2) Travel to Helios Library near Ludus Lake\r\n\r\n

- #eFinal Reward#n  \r\n
